en.name: Cultured butter
en.summary: Cultured butter is churned from cream that was soured with a lactic culture first, which is why it tastes deeper and more lactic than sweet-cream butter. A dish on the counter is fine for 1–2 days; refrigerated it runs 1–2 months, and frozen 6–9 months.
en.pantry: A covered butter dish on the counter is fine for 1–2 days, and no longer for an unsalted cultured butter — this is the style most likely to go rancid on you, because the culture leaves it slightly acidic and it usually carries little or no salt. Keep the dish covered and out of the light: light and air, not bacteria, are what turn butter. Put out only what you will spread in a couple of days and leave the rest cold.
en.fridge: The published figure for butter is 1–2 months refrigerated, and that is a safety figure. For quality there is a stricter published line of about a week or two, and that is the better guide here, because butter picks up every smell in the fridge and cultured butter has a delicate flavour to lose. Keep it wrapped, in a closed box, away from onions and cut cheese, and on a shelf rather than the door. Both numbers are for butter generally; no agency separates cultured from sweet-cream butter, and there is no safety reason to.
en.freezer: Cultured butter freezes for 6–9 months at −18 °C (0 °F). Freeze it in its original wrapper inside a bag — the wrapper is greaseproof and the bag keeps the freezer smells out — and label the date. Frozen food stays safe indefinitely at −18 °C, so those months are a quality window, and it is the residual buttermilk and the fat that eventually go off-flavour. Freeze it in blocks rather than cutting it up.
en.thawing: Thaw it in the fridge, still wrapped, not on the counter. For baking you can grate it straight from frozen. Do not refreeze thawed butter.
spoilage: A sharp, crayon-like or cheesy smell — the fat has gone rancid.
A darker, translucent yellow edge where the surface has oxidised.
Any mould, especially in the folds of the wrapper.
A bitter or soapy taste, or a stale flavour picked up from the fridge.
tips: Cut a week's worth off the block and keep the rest wrapped and cold.
Unsalted cultured butter is the shortest-lived of all butters — buy small.
Trim and discard a darkened surface rather than mixing it in.
Freeze the blocks you will not reach this month.

faq.q: How long does cultured butter keep in the fridge?
faq.a: The published butter figure is 1–2 months, but for flavour a week or two is a better target, especially for unsalted cultured butter.

faq.q: Can you leave cultured butter on the counter?
faq.a: For 1–2 days in a covered dish out of the light. Unsalted cultured butter goes rancid faster than salted sweet-cream butter, so do not stretch it.
Yes, 6–9 months at −18 °C. Freeze it in its wrapper inside a bag and thaw it in the fridge.

faq.q: Why does cultured butter taste different?
faq.a: The cream is soured with a lactic culture before churning, which lowers the pH and builds diacetyl. That extra flavour also means it goes off-flavour sooner.

zh.name: 發酵奶油
zh.summary: 發酵奶油是先把鮮奶油用乳酸菌發酵之後再攪打成的奶油，風味比一般甜奶油更深、乳酸味更明顯。放在室溫的奶油盒裡大約 1～2 天沒問題；冷藏約 1～2 個月，冷凍約 6～9 個月。
zh.pantry: 有蓋的奶油盒放在室溫 1～2 天沒問題，無鹽的發酵奶油就不要再久了——這是所有奶油裡最容易走油耗味的一種，因為發酵讓它帶點酸性，而且通常含鹽極低甚至無鹽。盒子要加蓋、避開光線：讓奶油變質的是光和空氣，不是細菌。只放兩天內抹得完的量，其餘留在冷藏。
zh.fridge: 奶油的公告冷藏期限是 1～2 個月，那是安全數字。就品質而言，另有一條更嚴格的公告說法是一兩週，在這裡反而是比較好的指引，因為奶油會吸收冰箱裡所有味道，而發酵奶油有細緻風味可以失去。包好、放密閉盒，遠離洋蔥和切開的乳酪，放層架不要放門邊。這兩個數字都是針對「奶油」通用的；沒有任何機構把發酵奶油和甜奶油分開，安全上也沒有必要分。
zh.freezer: 發酵奶油在 −18 °C 下可放 6～9 個月。連原本的包裝紙一起裝進袋子再冷凍——包裝紙防油，袋子擋氣味——並寫上日期。−18 °C 下安全性是無限期的，所以這幾個月講的是品質；最後走味的是殘留的酪乳和脂肪。整塊冷凍，不要先切小塊。
zh.thawing: 連包裝放冷藏解凍，不要放室溫。烘焙用的話可以直接從冷凍狀態刨絲。解凍過的奶油不要再次冷凍。
spoilage: 出現刺鼻的蠟筆味或起司臭味——脂肪已經油耗。
表面邊緣變成較深、半透明的黃色，那是氧化。
長霉，尤其在包裝紙摺縫處。
吃起來發苦、有肥皂味，或帶著冰箱的雜味。
tips: 從整塊上切下一週的量，其餘包好冰著。
無鹽發酵奶油是所有奶油裡最短命的——買小塊。
表面變色的部分切掉丟棄，不要拌進去。
這個月用不到的整塊直接冷凍。

faq.q: 發酵奶油冷藏可以放多久？
faq.a: 奶油的公告值是 1～2 個月，但就風味來說，一兩週是更好的目標，無鹽發酵奶油尤其如此。

faq.q: 發酵奶油可以放室溫嗎？
faq.a: 加蓋、避光的話 1～2 天沒問題。無鹽發酵奶油比含鹽甜奶油更快走油耗味，不要硬撐。
可以，−18 °C 下 6～9 個月。連包裝紙裝袋冷凍，放冷藏解凍。

faq.q: 發酵奶油為什麼味道不一樣？
faq.a: 因為鮮奶油先用乳酸菌發酵過才攪打，pH 值下降並生成雙乙醯。多出來的風味也代表它更快走味。
